Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied logic by comparing the directors’ ages at their films’ release years (1976 vs. 2009) instead of directly comparing their birth years. Despite having the correct birth years—Fernando Di Leo (1932) and Don Hahn (1955)—the Planner concluded Don Hahn was born earlier, which is false. The correct earlier birth is 1932, so Mister Scarface’s director was born earlier.
